mapper.select: SELECT a.license_id AS "license_id", a.license_name AS "license_name", TO_CHAR(a.last_modified, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "modified", NVL((SELECT DISTINCT l.license_type FROM apm_license_db_info l WHERE l.license_type IS NOT NULL AND ROWNUM=1), '-') AS "license_type" FROM apm_license a ORDER BY a.license_id

SELECT a.license_id AS "license_id", a.license_name AS "license_name", to_char(a.last_modified, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "modified", COALESCE((SELECT DISTINCT l.license_type FROM apm_license_db_info l WHERE l.license_type IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1), '-') AS "license_type" FROM apm_license a ORDER BY a.license_id

SELECT d.db_id AS "db_id", d.instance_name AS "instance_name", d.host_ip AS "host_ip", d.port AS "port", NVL(l.valid, 'N/A') AS "valid", NVL(l.license_type, '-') AS "license_type", NVL(l.license_status, '-') AS "license_status", NVL(TO_CHAR(l.core), '-') AS "core", NVL(TO_CHAR(l.last_modified, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), '-') AS "last_check" FROM apm_db_info d LEFT JOIN apm_license_db_info l ON d.db_id = l.db_id ORDER BY d.db_id

SELECT d.db_id AS "db_id", d.instance_name AS "instance_name", d.host_ip AS "host_ip", d.port AS "port", COALESCE(l.valid, 'N/A') AS "valid", COALESCE(l.license_type, '-') AS "license_type", COALESCE(l.license_status, '-') AS "license_status", COALESCE(l.core::text, '-') AS "core", COALESCE(to_char(l.last_modified, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), '-') AS "last_check" FROM apm_db_info d LEFT JOIN apm_license_db_info l ON d.db_id = l.db_id ORDER BY d.db_id
